headlines.title: Death toll climbs to more than 600 with thousands still missing in Nepal and Tibet
headlines.description: The death toll from catastrophic flash floods and mudslides in Nepal rose to at least 675 on Saturday, as nearly 2,500 people remained missing in the country, including around 90 Americans.

headlines.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. headlines.title: Milo Yiannopoulos deported to the U.K. one day after ICE arrest
headlines.description: Milo Yiannopoulos, a controversy-baiting internet personality who once vehemently backed President Donald Trump, has been deported to the United Kingdom, a Department of Homeland Security spokesperson said on Saturday.

headlines.title: NASA readies to launch its next-generation space telescope
headlines.description: NASA on Sunday is set to launch a next-generation telescope into space that’s expected to survey hundreds of millions of stars and billions of galaxies.

headlines.title: Palestinian woman and NBC News team attacked by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank
headlines.description: Masked Israeli settlers attacked and injured a Palestinian woman and members of an NBC News team reporting in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Saturday.

headlines.description: A tennis star returns to the U.S. Open, a trial is set for a man accused of being the 9/11 mastermind, and a social media lawsuit reaches a settlement.

headlines.title: DATELINE FRIDAY SNEAK PEEK: The Other Side of Paradise
headlines.description: A father in Hawaii tackles setback after setback in his fight for justice for his murdered daughter. Keith Morrison reports Friday, August 28 at 10/9c on NBC.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Taylor Swift donates $50,000 to a Rhode Island mother who was left seriously injured in car accident
